rationale: Read complete original bodies, tables, assertion inputs and relevant implementation. Preserve actual parse/dispatch/output boundaries and independent expected behaviors; repairs/consolidations are case-specific.

cases.title: suggests the closest command for a near-miss verb
cases.reason: Exact same input/assertion is retained in the existing near-miss destructive-verb case, which checks both canonical and alias suggestions together.

cases.title: includes alias paths among suggestions
cases.reason: Exact same input/assertion is retained alongside canonical suggestion in the existing near-miss destructive-verb case.

cases.title: returns nothing for a wildly-off token
cases.reason: Distant token yields no suggestion rather than fabricated recovery.

cases.title: only considers commands of the same depth
cases.reason: Extra command depth excludes otherwise nearby shorter commands.

cases.title: suggests a top-level command group near-miss
cases.reason: Top-level near miss yields deduplicated command group.

cases.title: ranks closer matches first
cases.reason: Nearest terminal command is ranked first.

cases.title: never suggests a destructive command for a benign non-destructive typo
cases.reason: Benign move typo excludes all three destructive canonical/alias deletion spellings.

cases.title: still suggests remove for a near-miss of a destructive verb
cases.reason: Genuine remov typo retains both canonical rm and declared remove alias.

cases.title: still suggests delete for a near-miss of the delete alias
cases.reason: Genuine delet typo retains delete alias.

cases.title: guards destructive commands outside the delete-family via the spec flag
cases.reason: Non-deletion destructive flag still distinguishes benign ball from intended kil.

cases.title: still recovers non-destructive near-misses
cases.reason: Ordinary list near miss still recovers.

cases.title: does not suggest hidden compatibility commands
cases.reason: Hidden compatibility command remains excluded from typo recovery.

cases.title: produces a human nextSteps line when a suggestion exists
cases.reason: Actual error-data wrapper retains canonical suggestion and reusable human next step.

cases.title: produces empty nextSteps when nothing is close
cases.reason: No nearby input yields empty suggestions and no invented next steps.

cases.title: does not route a benign typo into a destructive nextStep
cases.reason: Actual error-data wrapper never emits destructive remove recovery for benign move.
